root_cause: ToolController represented unresolved controlled-tool arguments with the string sentinel [invalid]. Experiment result construction then attempted to place that internal sentinel in ActionRecord.target, whose unchanged SafeId contract rejects brackets, so canonical Pydantic construction crashed.

implementation.scenario_provenance_correction: The formal manifest derives scenario version 1.1 from a representative generated evaluator instance used by formal cells and uses the same frozen scenario-source hash recorded by canonical cell results; a regression compares both fields with that actual scenario.
implementation.fresh_canary_gate_correction: Before manifest creation or runner invocation, formal execution verifies only results/experiment-002r-canary-2.json against frozen SHA-256 5b7c60d2399481d684f86a5df21f2b1f572f37cbe39a3d2488bf08ccb326d16c and exact schema, provider, model, parameters, complete control gates, and canary_passed state. Missing, old, altered, or semantically wrong artifacts fail closed.
implementation.actual_path_integration: V2Agent and V2Run now carry typed ActionAttemptRecord values; run_experiment_v2_cell executes exactly one canonical v2 cell; run_experiment_v2 composes it only for non-formal callers; experiment002r formal execution uses FormalBatch one cell at a time under the new experiment-002r-new-attempt identifier and never calls the full-matrix helper.
implementation.typed_attempts: ActionAttemptRecord keeps original attempted arguments, a nullable validated target, validation and authorization decisions, execution status, denial reason, tool outcome, and a safe failure category. Only executed response actions with a resolved SafeId target become ordinary ActionRecord values.
implementation.semantic_correctness: The ActionRecord SafeId regex, scoring, scenario, autonomy, authorization, protocol and model decision contracts are unchanged. Invalid, denied and recommendation-only attempts cannot execute or enter scoring actions. Valid executed actions retain ordinary ActionRecord behavior.
implementation.checkpointing: FormalBatch validates typed outcomes, writes each immutable per-run canonical checkpoint through a same-directory temporary file, flushes and fsyncs it, publishes with an exclusive hard-link operation, and fsyncs the directory. Mutable status uses flushed/fsynced temporary-file plus atomic replace.
implementation.manifest: Immutable manifest includes experiment ID, complete expected run cells/count, Git state, BlueRange/runtime versions, prompt and scenario hashes/version, provider/model/parameters, seeds/profiles/autonomies through the cells, and start timestamp.
implementation.failure_behavior: Unexpected exceptions produce an atomic sanitized forensic checkpoint, mark the active run FAILED, preserve prior COMPLETED checkpoints, leave later runs PENDING, mark the experiment ABORTED, stop immediately, and create no aggregate. Reopening an ABORTED batch cannot promote or resume it.
implementation.forensics: ForensicRecord includes run/cell, provider and model-turn audits, JSON/schema validity, parsed decision, attempted action, validation and authorization details, tool status, safe failure category, token/latency measurements, exception category, and sanitized message. Recursive secret-name and secret-value removal is tested.

crash_recovery.duplicate_run_id: PASS: typed manifest validation fails closed

limitations: The repair was exercised only with deterministic synthetic providers and synthetic batch callbacks; no benchmark or real provider was run.
Directory fsync is best-effort on platforms that do not support opening or syncing directories.
No attempt was made to recover, reinterpret, merge, or resume aborted Experiment 002R data.
